d.d: The name of the Latin script letter Y/y.
A Y-shaped object: a wye level, wye-connected. Especially a Y-shaped connection of three sections of road or railroad track.
d.x: A wye is used to split a single line [hose or cable] into two lines.

d.d: To make something into a wye (letter Y) shape.
d.x: When a hose line is divided into two or more lines, these lines are known as wyed lines.

d.d: To reverse the direction of a train using a wye.
d.x: Since the train didn't have a control cab at the other end, they wyed the train to turn it around for the trip back to the city.
